thread:
Samir (CS): FYI — Veritas Labs asked to onboard a private, multi-doc summarizer that needs PHI handling + HSM keying. They want throughput ~20 qps, 2000 token context, low-latency tails. Can we map next steps?
Emma (CS): Thanks — do we have model preference from them (open vs proprietary) and target model size? also renewal at-risk flag?
Samir (CS): Customer said they'd prefer an open 13B quantized variant if we can support HSM; otherwise willing to try our 13B-quantized-redwood-compat. Renewal flagged medium risk (contract review in 6 weeks).
Diego (Solutions Eng): Ok — immediate items: 1) PHI treatment plan 2) KMS/HSM onboarding checklist 3) eval harness (safety + hallucination + ROUGE/QA metrics)
Priya (ML Eng): For evals I need: sample documents (anonymized) or a synthetic sample that mirrors their doc distribution, plus target labels for summaries (n=500 ideally). Also need latency P95 targets and acceptable ROUGE/L doc-level baselines.
Samir (CS): I can ask Veritas for a 200-sample de-identified pack today and confirm whether we can use synthetic for initial tuning. I’ll also push them to sign our DPA and HSM access form.
Emma (CS): Can someone draft a minimal intake checklist I can share with the customer? Short checklist: data samples, compliance contact, acceptance criteria, SLA expectations.
Diego (Solutions Eng): Dropping a quick config snippet for initial runtime estimate:
```
model: redwood-13b-quantized-v1
context_window: 2048
batching: auto
target_qps: 20
hsm: true
```
Diego (Solutions Eng): Note: if they need 2000 token contexts we'll need to run a 32k-window variant or do windowing; cost/latency tradeoff to surface.
Priya (ML Eng): Suggested eval metrics: ROUGE-L, BERTScore, factuality-check (QA-based), and hallucination-rate measured via targeted queries. I can spin up a small eval harness once we have 200 samples.
Samir (CS): ingest-bot created intake ticket CS-7902 and added contract link: https://redwood.example.com/cs/intake/CS-7902 :thumbsup:
ingest-bot: Ticket CS-7902 created and assigned to samir.cs@redwood for follow-up.
Emma (CS): Great. Assigning owners: Samir -> customer comms + legal/DPA; Diego -> infra/HSM config + runtime tradeoffs; Priya -> eval plan + metrics. Will set a 30-min sync — is 3pm PT tomorrow ok?
Samir (CS): 3pm PT works. I'll ask Veritas to join (they want product + infra). Anything else?
Diego (Solutions Eng): One more: confirm data residency/region (they're EU-first), we may need private deployment in eu-west and KMS in customer's tenant.
Priya (ML Eng): I'll prepare a small template for expected eval output (CSV with id, doc_len, rouge_l, bertscore, qa_f1, hallucination_flag) and link it in the meeting notes.
Samir (CS): Perfect. I'll post the sync invite and paste this checklist into the ticket. Thanks all.
